shared_component_impact_check.wave_A_relevance: Wave A's 6 states are all the already-mounted /admin/pos caisse SPA (POS-wizard, a separate Vanilla-JS frozen surface loaded inside the backend theme) — not a cold-load transition through DefaultComponent's theme-resolution branch under test by the fix. Checked for any incidental impact anyway since the fix touches a component that wraps every route.

console.json: zero level=error entries in states 01-04 and 06; state 05 has exactly 3 level=error entries, all http://127.0.0.1:9100/health and :9101/health ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED — pre-existing, allowlisted printer-bridge health-probe noise (same class documented in round-2 wave-B findings, local bridges not running in this test/dev context, unrelated to DefaultComponent).
